facts.fact: Fraternité Matin reports the education minister launched the Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE) on 10 July 2025, funded by the MCC, tested in the pilot regions of Bouaké and San Pedro and to be extended to the whole country pending financing.
